core_business: Kompanion Bank is a Kyrgyz commercial bank and former microfinance institution specialized in rural and community development finance. Founded in October 2004 by Mercy Corps through the consolidation of five microcredit agencies, it obtained a full banking license in 2016 and today serves over 350,000 clients across more than 100 service points and 2,300+ agents nationwide. Core offerings include micro and small business loans, rural/agricultural lending, consumer deposits, money transfers (RIA, Western Union, etc.), virtual and plastic cards, mobile banking (Kompanion App and Kompanion Business App), and QR-code payments via the Elcart national network. The bank also operates a unique Community Technical Support Department providing free agronomy and veterinary advisory services, and runs longstanding CSR projects (Apple Festival, Asyl Mal, Smart Investments, Gardens and Plastic, financial literacy trainings).
apec_stance: Kompanion Bank positions itself as a socially responsible financial institution focused on rural financial inclusion and SME development across the Kyrgyz Republic. It is the first and only Kyrgyz member of the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV), and partners extensively with international development agencies active in APEC-adjacent regions: IFAD and the EU on the REMIT PRIME Central Asia remittances programme (2025); ADB on a USD 5 million MSME loan with a focus on women entrepreneurs (project 56005-001); IFC on microfinance portfolio support; and FMO and Triodos Investment Management as long-standing impact investors. The bank's November 2025 acquisition by Solaris Finance Limited (ROX Group) integrates Kompanion into a Vietnam-linked international conglomerate, deepening Central Asia-Southeast Asia financial connectivity that aligns with APEC's agenda on inclusive digital finance and cross-border investment.
profile: Kompanion Bank (康帕尼翁银行, Компаньон Банк, CJSC, NBKR No.053) is a Bishkek-headquartered commercial bank rooted in two decades of community development microfinance. Founded in October 2004 by the international NGO Mercy Corps through the consolidation of five microcredit agencies established since 1997, it was originally registered as the Microcredit Company 'Financial Group Kompanion,' reorganized into a closed joint stock company in April 2009, and obtained a full banking license from the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic in 2016. As of 2026, the bank serves over 350,000 clients through a head office at 62 Shota Rustaveli St., Bishkek, plus branches, savings offices, and 2,300+ agents across the country, ranking among the top Kyrgyz financial institutions by rural outreach and digital banking adoption. Kompanion pioneered the integration of microfinance with agronomy/veterinary extension work via its Community Technical Support Department, and runs flagship CSR programs on horticulture, pasture management, financial literacy, and environmental protection. The bank was the first Kyrgyz institution to join the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (2023) and won the European Microfinance Award (2014) and the CERISE+SPTP Gold Certificate for Client Protection. On 14 November 2025, 100% of shares were acquired by Solaris Finance Limited, a strategic partner of ROX Group (Vietnam-linked international conglomerate), from previous shareholders Mercy Corps, FMO, and Triodos Investment Management, ushering in a new phase of digital transformation and Southeast Asian capital integration. Key leadership: CEO Margarita Cherikbaeva (Chair of the Management Board); Board Chair Nguyen Thi Thien Huong (approved 12 February 2026).
